bearer.description: Authenticate every request with a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Accepts a Maple API key (`maple_ak_…`) or a dashboard session token (Clerk / self-hosted JWT). API keys may be restricted with scopes (see the `Scope` schema). A device-bound access token from `POST /v2/device_tokens` is sent as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` together with a `DPoP` proof header (RFC 9449) instead.

info.description:
The Maple public API is a resource-oriented REST interface for customer-stable resources and workflows.
It follows Stripe's design philosophy, modernized where useful:

- **Resources** are plural nouns under `/v2` (`/v2/api_keys`). Related resources share a product namespace (`/v2/alerts/rules`, `/v2/alerts/destinations`). Non-CRUD verbs are sub-resource POSTs (`/v2/api_keys/{id}/roll`).
- **Object IDs** are opaque, prefixed strings (`key_…`, `dash_…`) — reversible encodings of internal IDs.
- **Wire format** is snake_case JSON with an `object` type field on every resource and ISO-8601 UTC timestamps.
- **Lists** use cursor pagination and a uniform `{ object: "list", data, has_more, next_cursor }` envelope.
- **Errors** use a uniform `{ error: { _tag, type, code, title, message, retryable, recovery } }` envelope. `_tag` is the semantic Maple error identity; `code` remains the stable public integration key.
- **Auth** is a Bearer API key (`maple_ak_…`) or dashboard session token; keys can be restricted with scopes.

See `docs/api-v2.md` for the full conventions.

tags.description: Programmatic credentials for the Maple API. Create scoped keys, list and retrieve them, roll their secrets, and revoke them. Creating, rolling, and revoking keys is admin-only; a key's `secret` is returned only when it is created or rolled.
tags.name: API Keys

tags.description: Create and manage dashboards, browse version history, restore snapshots, and instantiate built-in templates.
tags.name: Dashboards

tags.description: Monitors over your telemetry: error rate, latency percentiles, Apdex, throughput, metrics, query-builder queries, and raw SQL. Rules evaluate on a rolling window, open incidents after consecutive breaches, and notify their alert destinations. Mutations are admin-only.
tags.name: Alert Rules

tags.description: Read-only notification delivery history for alert rules.
tags.name: Alert Deliveries

tags.description: Notification channels for alert rules — PagerDuty, generic webhooks, Hazel OAuth, Discord, Telegram, workspace-member email, and channels in linked chat workspaces. Create and manage destinations, then reference them from alert rules via `destination_ids`. Mutations are admin-only; channel secrets are write-only.
tags.name: Alert Destinations

tags.description: The incident history produced by your alert rules. Incidents open when a rule breaches for enough consecutive checks and resolve automatically once the signal recovers — this surface is read-only.
tags.name: Alert Incidents

tags.description: Telemetry ingest credentials for your organization: a public key for client-side senders and a private key for server-side senders. Retrieve them or roll either key. All operations are admin-only.
tags.name: Ingest Keys

tags.description: Everything that sends data to your organization: OpenTelemetry SDKs and collectors, Kubernetes clusters, Prometheus scrapes and cloud integrations. Push sources get their own token with allowed signals, a rate limit and resource attributes. All operations are admin-only.
tags.name: Sources

tags.description: Link a chat workspace to your organization through a configured connector, and manage or remove the links that already exist. Where a connector's platform can say who acted, each member may also link their own chat account to their Maple user.
tags.name: Chat Integrations

tags.description: Connect PlanetScale to your organization and manage what Maple collects from it: connection status, organization binding, the metrics service token that enables branch-metrics scraping, the database inventory, webhook setup, query insights, and the lifecycle event timeline.
tags.name: PlanetScale Integration

tags.description: Connect Google Cloud projects, folders or organizations: register a connector, choose whether it forwards logs and whether Maple may read metrics and resources, fetch the `gcloud` scripts that set it up, and see whether logs are arriving.
tags.name: Google Cloud Integration

tags.description: Connect AWS accounts: register a connection, choose what Maple may read, fetch the CloudFormation stack that sets it up, and see whether Maple can assume its role.
tags.name: AWS Integration

tags.description: Deduplicated errors and alert-backed issues tracked through Maple's triage workflow.
tags.name: Error Issues

tags.description: Ingest-time attribute rewrite rules. Move or copy span/resource attribute values to new keys as telemetry arrives, normalizing naming across services without redeploying them.
tags.name: Attribute Mappings

tags.description: The organization's append-only audit trail — allowed and denied actions performed through the dashboard, the public API, MCP, and any linked chat platform, attributed to the user, API key, or agent that performed them, with before/after diffs for updates. Reading it requires organization-administrator access (or the `audit_log:read` scope for API keys).
tags.name: Audit Log

tags.description: Metrics endpoints Maple scrapes on a schedule — self-hosted Prometheus endpoints and PlanetScale branch metrics. Manage targets, probe them on demand, and inspect recent scrape checks. Credentials are write-only.
tags.name: Scrape Targets

tags.description: Automatically detected instrumentation improvements — attribute renames toward canonical semantic conventions, double emissions, and naming violations. List them, and dismiss or reopen individual recommendations.
tags.name: Instrumentation Recommendations

tags.description: A health check for your Maple setup — what you are ingesting, whether alerts can reach you, and whether your telemetry follows the conventions Maple's features depend on.
tags.name: Setup Audit

tags.description: Which signals are reaching Maple. The input every empty state needs to tell 'nothing is wired up' apart from 'nothing happened'.
tags.name: Telemetry Signals

tags.description: Durable investigation war-rooms — autonomous or human-opened diagnostic sessions over incidents and ad-hoc questions, each carrying its structured AI diagnosis.
tags.name: Investigations

tags.description: Baseline-detected anomalies on monitored signals — list and inspect incidents, resolve them, link error issues, and manage detector settings.
tags.name: Anomalies

tags.description: The authenticated organization's identity.
tags.name: Organization

tags.description: Activation steps a new org completes to earn a credit, and the claim that applies it.
tags.name: Onboarding Checklist

tags.description: A shared Slack channel between the org and the Maple team.
tags.name: Support Channel

tags.description: Push-notification registrations for the native apps. Per user, per organization.
tags.name: Mobile Devices

tags.description: MCP clients connected to the organization through OAuth, and revoking them. Org admins manage every member's connections; other members manage their own.
tags.name: MCP Connections

tags.description: Feedback about Maple from agents: bugs, missing capabilities, misleading docs.
tags.name: Agent Feedback

tags.description: Recorded browser sessions — search them, retrieve detail, stream rrweb event chunks, read the distilled transcript, and reverse-correlate from a trace.
tags.name: Session Replays

tags.description: Search and inspect distributed traces.
tags.name: Traces

tags.description: Search and retrieve OpenTelemetry logs.
tags.name: Logs

tags.description: Browse and query OpenTelemetry metrics.
tags.name: Metrics

tags.description: Observed service health summaries.
tags.name: Services

tags.description: Service-to-service topology.
tags.name: Service Map

tags.description: The deployment environments telemetry has been observed in.
tags.name: Environments

tags.description: Read a dashboard through a share link. The only unauthenticated group in this API: the token in the request body is the credential, so these operations resolve for a viewer with no Maple account.
tags.name: Shares

tags.description: The single read behind the Maple mobile Home Screen widgets. Deliberately its own scope family so a device credential can be fenced to it alone.
tags.name: Widget Summary

tags.description: Device-scoped, read-only credentials for the Maple mobile Home Screen widgets. Minted by a signed-in app for one installation at a time.
tags.name: Widget Credentials

tags.description: Device-held keys for the Maple mobile Home Screen widgets. A signed-in app registers a key; the widget then authenticates with DPoP (RFC 9449) proofs signed by it.
tags.name: Device Credentials

tags.description: The DPoP token endpoint for device credentials. Unauthenticated apart from the proof.
tags.name: Device Tokens
